metadata.description: Aggregator marketplace: installs every Riley skill from the three domain repos (pm, coding, thinking) in one place, plus the control-plane tooling that backs up routines and settings and captures cross-session learnings. Each domain plugin is sourced from its home repo.

plugins.name: riley-control-plane
plugins.description: Hub tooling that keeps the whole setup in git: backs up routines (scheduled triggers) and Claude Code settings to this repo, restores them, and captures cross-session learnings into versioned global memory or a promoted skill. Pairs with publish-skill-to-github (which routes skills to the domain repos).

plugins.name: riley-pm-skills
plugins.description: Riley's own product-management skills: PRD, FDD, and business-rule spec writing, stakeholder decks, competitive research reports.

plugins.name: pm-skills-deanpeters
plugins.description: 12 product-management skills by Dean Peters (Productside), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: discovery, JTBD, prioritization, roadmapping, PoL probes, user stories.

plugins.name: pm-skills-digidai
plugins.description: Gene Dai's product-manager-skills (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0): SaaS metrics diagnosis, PRD critique, PLG growth strategy, PM career coaching.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Jesse Vincent's superpowers (MIT): a coding-agent methodology in 14 skills — TDD, systematic debugging, planning, code review, git worktrees. Named 'superpowers' so the skills' internal cross-references resolve.

plugins.name: anthropic-coding-skills
plugins.description: Engineering example skills from anthropics/skills (Apache 2.0): mcp-builder, webapp-testing, web-artifacts-builder, frontend-design, claude-api.

plugins.name: antislop
plugins.description: Miqdad Badjuber's anti-slop (MIT): a filter that stops AI coding agents from shipping generic UI, copy, and code comments, in 6 skills plus a mandatory delivery gate.

plugins.name: riley-thinking-skills
plugins.description: Riley's own thinking and general skills: decision-partner, decision-review, practice-partner, reflection-partner, Canadian personal-finance modelling, chess coaching, Quebec French tutoring, a pre-ship quality checker, a broken-integration diagnostician, and the skill-publishing tool.

plugins.name: anthropic-example-skills
plugins.description: Example skills from anthropics/skills (Apache 2.0): doc co-authoring, internal comms, algorithmic art, brand guidelines, theme factory, Slack GIF creator, Claude Academy guide, discernment nudge.

plugins.name: writing-skills-obra
plugins.description: Jesse Vincent's Elements of Style packaging (public domain): Strunk's 1918 rules applied to documentation, commit messages, and any prose an agent writes.

plugins.name: avoid-ai-writing
plugins.description: Conor Bronsdon's avoid-ai-writing (MIT): audits and rewrites prose to strip AI writing patterns, with detect, rewrite, and edit modes and voice profiles.
